note: How each Unit is executed (harness/recipes.py). status draft = not yet run on a real topic.

write.task: P1 Gap2Hypo for generation $K: from p1_prefill.json and question.json write the RQ, hypotheses and rival explanations of $GEN/step8_hypothesis.md and argument.json's claims, derivation and rivals[].id.

P1 Gap2Hypo for generation $K: from p1_prefill.json and question.json write the RQ, hypotheses and rival explanations of $GEN/step8_hypothesis.md and argument.json's claims, derivation and rivals[].id. This is the round-2 revision entering at this step: read the decision $RD/_state/harness/decisions/gen_$K/B5.round2.json and the Round 2 entry of $GEN/reflection_log.md, and produce this step's part again from the revised design - never patch it.

P2 design for generation $K: the rest of $GEN/step8_hypothesis.md and the design fields of argument.json (experiments, evidence, construction, controls aimed at named rivals, power, scope, external_check); the compute gate reads the probe.

P2 design for generation $K: the rest of $GEN/step8_hypothesis.md and the design fields of argument.json (experiments, evidence, construction, controls aimed at named rivals, power, scope, external_check); the compute gate reads the probe. This is the round-2 revision entering at this step: read the decision $RD/_state/harness/decisions/gen_$K/B5.round2.json and the Round 2 entry of $GEN/reflection_log.md, and produce this step's part again from the revised design - never patch it.
P3 decision tree for generation $K: write $GEN/decision_tree.json from the prefill - a node per deciding experiment, typed leaves, prior floors only raised by evidence.

P3 decision tree for generation $K: write $GEN/decision_tree.json from the prefill - a node per deciding experiment, typed leaves, prior floors only raised by evidence. This is the round-2 revision entering at this step: read the decision $RD/_state/harness/decisions/gen_$K/B5.round2.json and the Round 2 entry of $GEN/reflection_log.md, and produce this step's part again from the revised design - never patch it.
P4 attack-type Related Work for generation $K: write $GEN/attack_plan.json (target x weakness x weapon E-id x landing leaf x if_miss x concession) from the handover's targets.

P5 packaging for generation $K: write $GEN/packaging.json (the abstract sentence by sentence with move and sources, titles per likely leaf, tree_gate), then compose Experiments and Risk Factors and Limitations from argument.json into $GEN/idea_draft.json as research-cycle section 6 says.

B5 round 1 for generation $K (research-cycle section 5, 'On the fusion block'): the round's lookups (shortlist and raw novelty checks, the excluded lookup), the checks argument-check --idea, tree-check, attack-check --idea and pack-check --idea on $GEN/idea_draft.json pasted into $GEN/reflection_log.md under '## Round 1/N'. Do not revise yet: the round's ERRORs are fixed in round 2.
Restate this research idea as a blind reader, following the blind-restatement brief of the rules, and answer with the JSON it asks for.

B5 round 2 for generation $K: the critique - the 12 skeptical-reader questions, the comparison with restatement_1.json, the four tree questions - appended to $GEN/reflection_log.md as '## Round 2/N'; then ONE decision, written to $RD/_state/harness/decisions/gen_$K/B5.round2.json as {"decision": "finalize"} or {"decision": "revise", "enters": "P1"|"P2"|"P3", "reason": "...", "revision": {...}} (the earliest step the revision changes). Every round-1 ERROR and every reader doubt needs an answer.

B5 round 3 for generation $K: rewrite $GEN/idea_draft.json on the current design (Experiments and Risk recomposed), the compute gate and the worth-it check, then argument-check --idea. If C22 says the primary claim changed since round 1, write {"changed": true} to $RD/_state/harness/decisions/gen_$K/restatement2.json. Log it as '## Round 3/N'.
Restate this research idea as a blind reader, following the blind-restatement brief of the rules, and answer with the JSON it asks for.

FinalizeIdea for generation $K: write $GEN/idea.json - exactly the 7 keys in order (Name, Title, Short Hypothesis, Related Work, Abstract, Experiments, Risk Factors and Limitations) - from idea_draft.json; every doubt the gates or the reader left goes into Risk Factors; close the log.

recipes.note: rounds and gates are driven by harness.steps.GenerationAgent

write.task: B6 for generation $K: consume the question (`ideate-tool consume <RD> --question <Q_NNN> --idea <Name>`, noting any uncovered part of the angle), write the prescriptive Body $GEN/body/B_draft_<Name>.md and the journal recommendations $GEN/step8_journal_recommendations.md (with dataset licences; the only web lookup of Stage B).

The decision gate T09 still fails after the forced revision: abandon generation $K's question (`ideate-tool consume <RD> --question <Q_NNN> --abandoned "<the gate's finding>"`). Append nothing to the archive.
